A weekend by the lake: the house, the water and the old forest

By a friend of the family

Every summer my family drives north to a small red house near the lake. The road is long, but the children always sleep in the car, and my father tells the same old stories about the first time he saw the water. When we finally arrive, the garden is full of flowers and the air smells of pine trees and fresh bread.

On the first morning I usually walk down to the river with a cup of coffee. The birds are loud, the sun is still low, and the world feels very quiet. Sometimes I see a fox at the edge of the forest, and once a beautiful crane stood in the shallow water for almost an hour before it flew away over the mountains.

In the afternoon we swim, read books on the old wooden bridge, or take the boat to the island. My mother prepares a simple dinner with fish, potatoes and a green salad, and we eat at the long table in the kitchen while the evening light turns the windows gold. Nobody checks the news, and nobody talks about work.

It is not an expensive holiday, and the house is far from perfect: the door to the bedroom does not close, the roof leaks when it rains, and the neighbor's dog barks at every car. But it is the most important week of the year for us, because the whole family is together and time seems to move more slowly.

  • Short item
  • Another short note
  • When you visit, bring warm clothes, because the nights near the water can be surprisingly cold even in the middle of summer.
